title: Normalizing the projection off a unit vector yields a unit vector
statement:
Let $u,v$ be unit vectors in a real inner product space, with $v 
eq u$ and $v 
eq -u$, and set $w = v - \langle u,vangle\, u$, the projection of $v$ onto the orthogonal complement of $\mathrm{span}\{u\}$. Then the rescaled vector $
orm{w}^{-1}\, w$ has norm $1$.
